check.n: Was 710 BC; Wikipedia and Shiji: Marquis Ai reigned until his capture by Quwo in 709 BC.
check.n_zh: 原作前710年；据维基百科及《史记》，晋哀侯于前709年被曲沃所俘，在位至前709年。

check.n: Wikipedia gives 516 BC – 469 BC; sources differ, the map keeps the dates it had.
check.n_zh: 维基百科作前516年—前469年；诸说不一，地图暂沿用原年代。

check.n: Wikipedia says reigned 34 years, died c. 760 BC (start c. 793 BC).
check.n_zh: 维基百科称在位34年，约前760年卒（即位约前793年）。

sides.name: Zhou royal army with Chen, Cai and Wey

battle-of-xuge.note: Zheng used a new 'fish-scale' formation mixing chariots and infantry.
battle-of-xuge.note_zh: 郑军采用战车与步兵配合的“鱼丽之阵”。
battle-of-xuge.losses: King Huan wounded in the shoulder by an arrow

battle-of-changshao.note: Cao Gui's advice: 'one drum rouses courage, a second weakens it, a third exhausts it.'
battle-of-changshao.note_zh: 曹刿论战：“一鼓作气，再而衰，三而竭。”

guo-yu.note: Jin took Guo's town Xiayang in 658 BCE and destroyed Guo in 655 BCE, then seized Yu on the way home.
guo-yu.note_zh: 晋于前658年攻取虢国的下阳，前655年灭虢，回师途中又灭虞。

battle-of-hong.losses: Song army routed; Duke Xiang wounded in the thigh and died the next year
battle-of-hong.losses_zh: 宋军大败，宋襄公大腿受伤，次年去世

sides.name: Jin with Qi, Qin and Song

chengpu.note: Jin pulled back three days' march to keep Chong'er's old promise to Chu, then beat Chu's weaker wings first.
chengpu.note_zh: 晋军遵守重耳当年对楚的承诺“退避三舍”，再先击破楚军较弱的两翼。
chengpu.losses: Ziyu took his own life after the defeat

battle-of-xiao.losses: The Qin army was wiped out and its three generals captured (later released)
battle-of-xiao.losses_zh: 秦军全军覆没，三帅被俘（后获释放）

qin-dominates-rong.note: The Records of the Grand Historian say Qin added twelve states and opened a thousand li of land.
qin-dominates-rong.note_zh: 《史记》称秦“益国十二，开地千里，遂霸西戎”。

battle-of-bi.note: Jin's generals quarrelled over whether to fight, and the army broke while crossing the Yellow River.
battle-of-bi.note_zh: 晋军将领对战与不战意见不一，渡黄河撤退时溃败。

battle-of-yanling.losses: King Gong lost an eye to an arrow; Zifan took his own life
battle-of-yanling.losses_zh: 楚共王被箭射中眼睛，子反自杀

qi-lai.losses: Lai destroyed; its ruler fled to Tang and was killed
qi-lai.losses_zh: 莱国灭亡，莱共公逃到棠后被杀

wu-xu.note: Wu dammed a river by the hills and flooded the Xu capital.
wu-xu.note_zh: 吴军依山筑堤，引水灌徐都。
wu-xu.losses: Xu destroyed; its ruler fled to Chu
wu-xu.losses_zh: 徐国灭亡，徐君逃往楚国

sides.name: Chu
sides.troops_text_zh: 约20万（传统说法，可能夸大）

boju.note: The troop numbers are traditional estimates, not records; Sun Tzu's role comes from later sources.
boju.note_zh: 兵力为后世流传的说法而非原始记录；孙武参战之说出自较晚的史料。
boju.losses: Chu capital Ying taken; King Zhao of Chu fled
boju.losses_zh: 楚都郢被攻破，楚昭王出逃

battle-of-fujiao.losses: Goujian retreated to Mount Kuaiji with 5,000 men and surrendered
battle-of-fujiao.losses_zh: 勾践率残兵五千退守会稽山，后求和投降

routes.name: King Ping moves the court to Luoyi
routes.summary: After Haojing fell, King Ping moved the Zhou court east along the Wei and Yellow rivers to Luoyi, starting the Eastern Zhou.
routes.summary_zh: 镐京陷落后，周平王沿渭河、黄河东迁洛邑，东周由此开始。

routes.name: Jin borrows the road through Yu
routes.summary: Jin's army marched south through the state of Yu to destroy Guo across the Yellow River, then took Yu on the way back.
routes.summary_zh: 晋军借道虞国南下，渡黄河灭虢，回师时顺手灭了虞国。

routes.name: Chong'er's 19 years in exile
routes.summary: Prince Chong'er fled Jin and wandered through the Di lands, Wey, Qi, Cao, Song, Zheng, Chu and Qin before returning with Qin's help to become Duke Wen; the Di stop is approximate.
routes.summary_zh: 公子重耳出逃后辗转狄、卫、齐、曹、宋、郑、楚、秦，最后在秦的帮助下回国即位为晋文公；狄地位置为大致位置。

routes.name: Jin's march to Chengpu
routes.summary: Jin crossed the Yellow River, struck Wey and Cao (Chu's allies), and met the Chu army at Chengpu.
routes.summary_zh: 晋军渡过黄河，先攻打楚的盟国卫和曹，随后在城濮迎战楚军。

routes.name: Qin's raid on Zheng and the ambush at Xiao
routes.summary: A Qin army marched a thousand li east to surprise Zheng, gave up at Hua and was trapped by Jin in the Xiao mountains on the way home.
routes.summary_zh: 秦军千里东进偷袭郑国，在滑国折返，归途中在崤山被晋军伏击。

routes.name: Wu's march on the Chu capital
routes.summary: Wu's army went up the Huai by boat, left the boats, crossed the passes into Chu, won at Boju and took Ying; the waypoints are approximate.
routes.summary_zh: 吴军乘船沿淮河西进，舍舟登陆，穿越隘口进入楚境，柏举获胜后攻入郢都；途经点为大致位置。

routes.name: Han Canal
routes.summary: Wu dug a canal from near Yangzhou north to the Huai River to move its armies north; it later became part of the Grand Canal.
routes.summary_zh: 吴国从今扬州附近向北开凿运河直通淮河，以便北上用兵；后来成为大运河的一部分。

routes.name: Fuchai marches north to Huangchi
routes.summary: Fuchai led his army north by the Han Canal and rivers to Huangchi to claim the leadership of the states, while Yue attacked his capital behind him.
routes.summary_zh: 夫差率军经邗沟和水路北上黄池，与晋争当盟主，而越国趁机攻入吴都。

people.name: Lady Xu Mu
people.known_for: Princess of Wei married into Xu; her poem in the Book of Songs on rushing home after Wei's fall makes her China's first known woman poet.
people.known_for_zh: 卫国公主，嫁到许国；卫国被狄攻破后她写下《载驰》，是中国已知最早的女诗人。
people.line_en: I drive and I gallop, home to mourn the Lord of Wei.

people.name: Guan Zhong
people.known_for: Chancellor of Qi whose economic reforms made Duke Huan the first hegemon.
people.known_for_zh: 齐国国相，推行经济改革，使齐桓公成为春秋第一位霸主。
people.line_zh: 仓廪实则知礼节，衣食足则知荣辱。
people.line_en: When granaries are full, people know propriety; when food and clothing suffice, they know honour and shame.

people.name: Shi Kuang
people.known_for: Blind court musician of Jin, remembered as the finest musician of ancient China.
people.known_for_zh: 晋国的盲人宫廷乐师，被后世视为古代最杰出的音乐家。

people.name: Zichan
people.known_for: Chief minister of Zheng who had the state's laws cast on bronze cauldrons in 536 BCE, making them public.
people.known_for_zh: 郑国执政，公元前536年把刑法铸在铜鼎上公之于众。

people.name: Deng Xi
people.known_for: Zheng lawyer and debater who wrote a law code on bamboo; an early figure of the School of Names.
people.known_for_zh: 郑国人，善辩论，曾把法律写在竹简上（竹刑），是名家的先驱。

people.name: Yan Ying
people.known_for: Thrifty, witty chancellor of Qi famous for blunt advice to his dukes.
people.known_for_zh: 齐国国相，以节俭、机智和敢于直言进谏著称。

people.name: Laozi
people.known_for: Keeper of the Zhou archives in tradition, and the reputed author of the Daodejing, founding text of Daoism.
people.known_for_zh: 相传为周朝守藏室之史，被认为是道家经典《道德经》的作者。
people.line_en: The Way that can be spoken of is not the constant Way.

people.name: Sunzi (Sun Wu)
people.known_for: Military thinker who served King Helü of Wu; author of The Art of War.
people.known_for_zh: 为吴王阖闾效力的军事思想家，著有《孙子兵法》。
people.line_en: Know the enemy and know yourself, and in a hundred battles you will not be in danger.

people.name: Confucius
people.known_for: Teacher whose ideas of humaneness, ritual and learning founded Confucianism; his sayings are in the Analects.
people.known_for_zh: 教育家、思想家，提倡仁、礼和学习，开创儒家；言行记于《论语》。
people.line_en: Is it not a pleasure to learn and to practise it from time to time?

people.name: Duke Huan of Qi
people.known_for: First of the Five Hegemons, who with Guan Zhong made Qi the leading power and rallied states against the barbarians.
people.known_for_zh: 春秋五霸之首，任用管仲，尊王攘夷，九合诸侯。

people.name: Bao Shuya
people.known_for: Qi minister who recommended his friend Guan Zhong as chancellor, the origin of the idiom 'friendship of Guan and Bao'.
people.known_for_zh: 举荐好友管仲为相，留下“管鲍之交”佳话。

people.name: Cao Gui
people.known_for: Lu strategist who defeated Qi at Changshao in 684 BC by attacking after the enemy's third drum roll.
people.known_for_zh: 长勺之战指挥鲁军败齐，“一鼓作气，再而衰，三而竭”。

people.name: Duke Xiang of Song
people.known_for: Aspiring hegemon of Song whose chivalrous refusal to attack an unready foe led to defeat at the Hong River.
people.known_for_zh: 泓水之战坚持“不鼓不成列”而败，以仁义著称。

people.name: Duke Wen of Jin
people.place_zh: 绛（晋国都城，今山西翼城）
people.known_for: After 19 years of exile he returned to rule Jin and became hegemon by defeating Chu at Chengpu.
people.known_for_zh: 流亡十九年后归国即位，城濮之战败楚成为霸主。

people.name: Jie Zitui
people.known_for: Loyal follower of the exiled Chong'er who refused reward and died in a fire, commemorated by the Cold Food Festival.
people.known_for_zh: 追随重耳流亡，割股奉君，不受封赏焚死绵山，寒食节由来。

people.name: Hu Yan
people.place_zh: 绛（晋国都城，今山西翼城）
people.known_for: Maternal uncle and chief adviser of Duke Wen of Jin, guiding him through exile and to hegemony.
people.known_for_zh: 晋文公舅父与谋臣，助其流亡归国并称霸。

people.name: Xian Zhen
people.place_zh: 绛（晋国都城，今山西翼城）
people.known_for: Jin's commander who won the Battle of Chengpu and ambushed the Qin army at Xiao.
people.known_for_zh: 晋国中军元帅，城濮之战与崤之战的主要指挥者。

people.name: Duke Mu of Qin
people.place_zh: 雍城（秦国都城，今陕西凤翔）
people.known_for: Qin ruler who employed talented outsiders, expanded west over the Rong, and is counted among the Five Hegemons.
people.known_for_zh: 任用百里奚、蹇叔等贤才，称霸西戎，春秋五霸之一。

people.name: Baili Xi
people.place_zh: 雍城（秦国都城，今陕西凤翔）
people.known_for: Ransomed for five ram skins, he became chancellor of Qin and helped Duke Mu dominate the west.
people.known_for_zh: 秦穆公以五张羊皮赎回任为大夫，号“五羖大夫”。

people.name: Jian Shu
people.place_zh: 雍城（秦国都城，今陕西凤翔）
people.known_for: Elder statesman of Qin famous for tearfully warning against the ill-fated raid that ended at Xiao.
people.known_for_zh: 秦国上大夫，哭师力谏伐郑，预言崤之战之败。

people.name: Zhao Dun
people.place_zh: 绛（晋国都城，今山西翼城）
people.known_for: Powerful chief minister of Jin whose clan later founded the state of Zhao.
people.known_for_zh: 晋国执政正卿，赵氏崛起的关键人物。

people.name: Dong Hu
people.place_zh: 绛（晋国都城，今山西翼城）
people.known_for: Jin court historian who recorded that Zhao Dun killed his ruler, the model of fearless honest history.
people.known_for_zh: 晋国太史，书“赵盾弑其君”，被孔子誉为良史。

people.name: King Zhuang of Chu
people.place_zh: 郢（楚国都城，今湖北荆州）
people.known_for: Chu king who 'flew to the sky in one leap', defeated Jin at Bi, and became one of the Five Hegemons.
people.known_for_zh: “一鸣惊人”，邲之战败晋，春秋五霸之一。

people.name: Sunshu Ao
people.place_zh: 郢（楚国都城，今湖北荆州）
people.known_for: Chancellor of Chu renowned for integrity and for building the Quebei reservoir, among China's earliest irrigation works.
people.known_for_zh: 楚国令尹，清廉贤能，主持修建芍陂水利工程。

people.name: Yang Youji
people.place_zh: 郢（楚国都城，今湖北荆州）
people.known_for: Chu general and legendary archer who could hit a willow leaf from a hundred paces.
people.known_for_zh: 楚国名将神射手，“百步穿杨”的典故出处。

people.name: Shuxiang
people.place_zh: 新田（晋国都城，今山西侯马）
people.known_for: Erudite Jin minister and opponent of Zi Chan's written penal code, admired by Confucius for his righteousness.
people.known_for_zh: 晋国贤大夫，博学正直，曾致书子产反对铸刑书。

people.name: Ji Zha
people.known_for: Prince of Wu who declined the throne and was renowned for his judgment of music and his sword promise to a dead friend.
people.known_for_zh: 吴国公子，三让王位，挂剑徐君墓，以贤德著称。

people.name: Wu Zixu
people.place_zh: 姑苏（吴国都城，今江苏苏州）
people.known_for: Chu exile who built up Wu, led it to capture Ying in 506 BC, and was forced to suicide for warning against Yue.
people.known_for_zh: 助吴建都强军，攻破楚都郢，后因谏阻越国被赐死。

people.name: Fuchai
people.place_zh: 姑苏（吴国都城，今江苏苏州）
people.known_for: King of Wu who crushed Yue and contested hegemony with Jin, only to be destroyed by Goujian's revenge.
people.known_for_zh: 吴王，败越称霸黄池，终被勾践所灭自尽。

people.name: Goujian
people.place_zh: 会稽（越国都城，今浙江绍兴）
people.known_for: King of Yue who 'slept on brushwood and tasted gall' to rebuild his state and annihilated Wu in 473 BC.
people.known_for_zh: 卧薪尝胆，十年生聚教训，终灭吴称霸。

people.name: Fan Li
people.place_zh: 会稽（越国都城，今浙江绍兴）
people.known_for: Adviser who helped Goujian destroy Wu, then retired to become a legendary merchant, later revered as a god of wealth.
people.known_for_zh: 辅佐勾践灭吴后功成身退，经商致富，号陶朱公。

people.name: Wen Zhong
people.place_zh: 会稽（越国都城，今浙江绍兴）
people.known_for: Yue minister whose seven strategies helped defeat Wu, but who was forced to suicide by Goujian afterward.
people.known_for_zh: 越国大夫，献灭吴九术，功成后被勾践赐死。

people.name: Ou Yezi
people.known_for: Legendary swordsmith of Yue said to have forged the Zhanlu, Chunjun and Longquan swords.
people.known_for_zh: 越国铸剑大师，相传铸湛卢、纯钧、龙泉等名剑。

people.name: Gan Jiang
people.place_zh: 姑苏（吴国都城，今江苏苏州）
people.known_for: Legendary Wu swordsmith who with his wife Mo Ye forged a famed pair of swords bearing their names.
people.known_for_zh: 吴国铸剑师，与妻莫邪铸成雌雄双剑。

people.name: Sima Rangju
people.known_for: Qi general under Duke Jing noted for strict discipline; his doctrines are preserved in the Methods of the Sima.
people.known_for_zh: 齐景公时大司马，治军严明，兵法收入《司马法》。

people.name: Chang Hong
people.known_for: Zhou court official versed in astronomy, calendar and music, whom Confucius reputedly consulted on music.
people.known_for_zh: 周室大夫，精通天文历数与音律，孔子曾向其问乐。

people.name: Zuo Qiuming
people.known_for: Lu historian traditionally credited with the Zuo Zhuan and Guoyu, masterpieces of early Chinese narrative history.
people.known_for_zh: 鲁国史官，相传著《左传》与《国语》。

people.name: Yan Hui
people.known_for: Confucius's favorite disciple, celebrated for his virtue and contentment in poverty.
people.known_for_zh: 孔子最得意的弟子，安贫乐道，后世尊为复圣。

people.name: Zilu
people.known_for: Bold and loyal disciple of Confucius who died in a coup in Wey, adjusting his cap before death.
people.known_for_zh: 孔子弟子，勇武忠直，死于卫国内乱，结缨而死。

people.name: Zigong
people.known_for: Eloquent disciple of Confucius, a skilled diplomat and wealthy merchant who reshaped interstate politics.
people.known_for_zh: 孔子弟子，善辞令外交，经商致富，“端木遗风”。

people.name: Lu Ban
people.known_for: Master carpenter and inventor of Lu, credited with siege ladders and many tools; patron saint of builders.
people.known_for_zh: 鲁国巧匠，相传发明云梯、锯等工具，被奉为木匠祖师。

people.name: Yu Boya
people.known_for: Qin zither virtuoso whose friendship with the listener Zhong Ziqi gave rise to the idea of a 'zhiyin', a true friend.
people.known_for_zh: 古琴名家，与钟子期“高山流水”结为知音。

people.name: Liuxia Hui
people.known_for: Lu official praised by Confucius and Mencius as a paragon of upright conduct and propriety.
people.known_for_zh: 鲁国大夫，以“坐怀不乱”与正直守礼著称。

people.name: Shen Baoxu
people.place_zh: 郢（楚国都城，今湖北荆州）
people.known_for: Chu official who wept seven days at the Qin court until Qin sent troops to save Chu from Wu.
people.known_for_zh: 吴破郢后哭秦庭七日，求得秦兵复楚。

people.name: Zengzi
people.known_for: Confucian disciple famed for filial piety and traditionally linked to the Great Learning.
people.known_for_zh: 孔子弟子，以孝著称，相传作《大学》，尊为宗圣。

capitals.name: Luoyi (Wangcheng)
capitals.note: King Ping moved the court east after Haojing fell.
capitals.note_zh: 镐京陷落后，周平王东迁洛邑。

capitals.name: Xinzheng
capitals.note: Zheng moved here after conquering Kuai; date approximate.
capitals.note_zh: 郑国灭郐后迁都于此，年代为约数。

capitals.name: Jiang
capitals.note: Old Jin capital; exact site debated.
capitals.note_zh: 晋国旧都，确切位置仍有争议。

capitals.name: Xintian (New Jiang)
capitals.note: Duke Jing of Jin moved the capital to Xintian.

capitals.name: Yong
capitals.note_zh: 秦国在此建都近三百年。

capitals.name: Ying
capitals.note: Chu capital from King Wen; identified with Jinancheng. Date traditional.
capitals.note_zh: 楚文王起定都于郢，一般认为即纪南城，年代为传统说法。

capitals.name: Diqiu
capitals.note: Wei moved here after the Di had driven it from Zhaoge.
capitals.note_zh: 卫国被狄人逐出朝歌后迁都于此。

capitals.name: Gusu
capitals.note: City built for King Helü by Wu Zixu.
capitals.note_zh: 伍子胥为吴王阖闾修筑的都城。

capitals.name: Kuaiji
capitals.note: City built for King Goujian; Yue later moved north to Langya.
capitals.note_zh: 为越王勾践修筑的都城，越国后来北迁琅琊。

capitals.name: Ji
capitals.note: Yan capital; the exact time it moved from Liulihe is uncertain.
capitals.note_zh: 燕国都城，从琉璃河迁来的确切时间不详。
